title: Rules System Expansion
brief: Create path-specific .claude/rules/*.md files for every major domain. Currently only 3 rules files (prism-mfg.md, prism-skills.md, prism-registries.md). Need rules for engines, dispatchers, hooks, tests, catalogs, CLI, MCP, schemas, skills, pipelines.

phases.title: Domain-Specific Rules Files
phases.description: Create 10 path-specific rules files covering all major code domains: engines, dispatchers, hooks, tests, catalogs, CLI, MCP, schemas, skills, pipelines.

units.title: rules/engines.md — engine coding conventions
units.rationale: Engines are the core computation layer (1078 files). Consistent conventions for formula documentation, error handling, and test pairing are critical for maintainability.
entry_conditions: .claude/rules/ directory exists with existing rules files
exit_conditions: Rules load for engine files matching **/engines/**/*.ts
Covers: naming, JSDoc, formula documentation, error handling, test file pairing, export patterns
Claude follows rules when editing engine files

steps.instruction: Analyze existing engine patterns: naming, structure, imports, exports
Create .claude/rules/engines.md with globs: ['**/engines/**/*.ts']
Document: PascalCase naming, JSDoc with @formula tags, physics units in comments, typed return objects
Document: every engine must have matching __tests__/ file, export from index.ts
Test: edit an engine file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for engine files: naming, JSDoc, formulas, test pairing, exports

units.description: rules/engines.md — engine coding conventions — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: rules/dispatchers.md — dispatcher conventions
units.rationale: Dispatchers (68 files) are the routing layer. z.enum synchronization, schema alignment, and naming consistency are the most common sources of bugs.
exit_conditions: Rules load for dispatcher files matching **/dispatchers/**
Covers: z.enum sync, schema requirements, lazy imports, action naming, handler patterns
Claude follows rules when editing dispatchers

steps.instruction: Analyze existing dispatcher patterns: z.enum, handler switch, lazy imports
Create .claude/rules/dispatchers.md with globs: ['**/dispatchers/**']
Document: z.enum must match all handler cases, lazy imports for engines, action names snake_case
Document: schema file required per dispatcher, no cross-dispatcher action name collisions
Test: edit a dispatcher file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for dispatchers: z.enum sync, schemas, lazy imports, naming

units.description: rules/dispatchers.md — dispatcher conventions — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: rules/hooks.md — hook shell standards
units.rationale: Hook scripts (9+ files) must follow strict conventions for JSON I/O, exit codes, and error handling to work correctly with Claude Code's hook system.
exit_conditions: Rules load for hook files matching **/.claude/hooks/**
Covers: JSON stdin/stdout, exit codes (0=pass, 1=warn, 2=block), error handling, state files
Claude follows rules when editing hooks

steps.instruction: Analyze existing hook patterns: stdin parsing, output format, exit codes
Create .claude/rules/hooks.md with globs: ['**/.claude/hooks/**']
Document: read JSON from stdin, output JSON to stdout, exit 0/1/2, use jq for parsing
Document: state files in /tmp/claude-*, dedup patterns, tracker file conventions
Test: edit a hook file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for hooks: JSON I/O, exit codes, state management, dedup patterns

units.description: rules/hooks.md — hook shell standards — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: rules/tests.md — test conventions
units.rationale: Tests (756 files, 17K+ cases) need consistent structure, naming, and coverage targets. Rules enforce describe/it nesting, assertion patterns, and file naming.
exit_conditions: Rules load for test files matching **/__tests__/** and **/*.test.ts
Covers: describe/it nesting, assertion style, edge case coverage, file naming
Claude follows rules when writing tests

steps.instruction: Analyze existing test patterns: describe nesting, assertion style, setup/teardown
Create .claude/rules/tests.md with globs: ['**/__tests__/**', '**/*.test.ts']
Document: describe('<EngineName>', () => { it('should...') }), expect() assertions, no any types
Document: test file naming matches engine: FooEngine.ts → FooEngine.test.ts, minimum 10 test cases
Test: create a test file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for tests: structure, naming, assertions, coverage targets

units.description: rules/tests.md — test conventions — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: rules/catalogs.md — data catalog conventions
units.rationale: Catalog data files (62 files, 95K+ tools) must follow strict typing, validation, and import patterns to maintain data integrity.
exit_conditions: Rules load for catalog files matching **/data/** and **/catalogs/**
Covers: TypeScript typing, data validation, import patterns, no raw JSON
Claude follows rules when editing catalogs

steps.instruction: Analyze existing catalog patterns: typing, exports, validation
Create .claude/rules/catalogs.md with globs: ['**/data/**', '**/catalogs/**']
Document: all catalog entries typed with interfaces, no 'any', validate with Zod schemas
Document: export as const arrays, use satisfies for type checking, include unit annotations
Test: edit a catalog file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for catalogs: typing, validation, exports, unit annotations

units.description: rules/catalogs.md — data catalog conventions — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: rules/cli.md — CLI conventions
units.rationale: CLI layer (4 files) uses Commander patterns with specific formatter, stdin, and config conventions that must be consistent.
exit_conditions: Rules load for CLI files matching **/cli/**
Covers: Commander patterns, formatters (json/table/csv/compact), stdin piping, config
Claude follows rules when editing CLI files

steps.instruction: Analyze existing CLI patterns: Commander setup, formatter usage, stdin detection
Create .claude/rules/cli.md with globs: ['**/cli/**']
Document: Commander .command()/.option()/.action() pattern, 4 output formats, TTY detection
Document: config from ~/.prism/config.json, stdin via process.stdin.isTTY check
Test: edit a CLI file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for CLI: Commander patterns, formatters, stdin, config

units.description: rules/cli.md — CLI conventions — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: rules/mcp.md — MCP conventions
units.rationale: MCP layer (6 files) follows specific tool annotation, resource, prompt, and completion patterns that differ from regular engine code.
exit_conditions: Rules load for MCP files matching **/mcp/**
Covers: tool annotations (readOnly/destructive/idempotent), resources, prompts, completions
Claude follows rules when editing MCP files

steps.instruction: Analyze existing MCP patterns: annotations, resources, prompts
Create .claude/rules/mcp.md with globs: ['**/mcp/**']
Document: tool annotations required for all dispatchers, resource URI templates, prompt structure
Document: completions for common argument types, progress reporter patterns
Test: edit an MCP file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for MCP: annotations, resources, prompts, completions

units.description: rules/mcp.md — MCP conventions — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: rules/schemas.md — Zod schema conventions
units.rationale: Schema files (60 files) define all action interfaces. Consistent Zod v4 patterns, naming, and validation are essential for type safety across the system.
exit_conditions: Rules load for schema files matching **/schemas/**
Covers: Zod v4 patterns, naming (camelCase actions, PascalCase types), validation, descriptions
Claude follows rules when editing schemas

steps.instruction: Analyze existing schema patterns: Zod v4 usage, naming, descriptions
Create .claude/rules/schemas.md with globs: ['**/schemas/**']
Document: Zod v4 z.object(), action names snake_case, .describe() on all fields
Document: export schema + inferred type, match dispatcher z.enum entries
Test: edit a schema file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for schemas: Zod v4 patterns, naming, descriptions, type inference

units.description: rules/schemas.md — Zod schema conventions — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: rules/skills.md — skill file conventions
units.rationale: Skill files (132+) need consistent frontmatter, trigger patterns, and content structure. Rules enforce the conventions established in CCM-MS3.
exit_conditions: Rules load for skill files matching **/skills/** and **/commands/**
Covers: frontmatter fields, trigger patterns, content structure, argument handling
Claude follows rules when creating/editing skills

steps.instruction: Analyze existing skill patterns: frontmatter, content, triggers
Create .claude/rules/skills.md with globs: ['**/skills/**', '**/commands/**']
Document: required frontmatter (model, effort, argument-hint), markdown content, step-by-step instructions
Document: trigger patterns, skill naming conventions, output format expectations
Test: edit a skill file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for skills: frontmatter, triggers, content structure, naming

units.description: rules/skills.md — skill file conventions — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: rules/pipelines.md — pipeline and orchestrator conventions
units.rationale: Pipeline and orchestrator engines (20+ files) handle async multi-stage processing. They need specific patterns for error handling, stage composition, and progress reporting.
exit_conditions: Rules load for pipeline files matching **/*Pipeline* and **/*Orchestrator*
Covers: async patterns, error handling, stage composition, progress reporting, retry logic
Claude follows rules when editing pipelines

steps.instruction: Analyze existing pipeline patterns: async/await, stage arrays, error accumulation
Create .claude/rules/pipelines.md with globs: ['**/*Pipeline*', '**/*Orchestrator*']
Document: async methods, try/catch per stage, error accumulation not early abort
Document: progress reporting via MCP reporters, stage ordering, input/output typing between stages
Test: edit a pipeline file and verify rules are loaded

deliverables.description: Path-specific rules for pipelines: async patterns, error handling, stages, progress reporting
